items.source: ClusterInfo gives access to cluster information such as cluster_state and cluster_slots_assigned provided by the CLUSTER INFO command.
items.translation: ClusterInfo 提供了对集群信息的访问，例如由 CLUSTER INFO 命令提供的 cluster_state 和 cluster_slots_assigned。
